about.description: The Hammered Crab is a beachfront seafood restaurant in Gulf Shores specializing in fresh crab legs, shrimp, and coastal cuisine. They offer all-you-can-eat crab legs and cater to groups and private events.

menu.name: Peel & Eat Shrimp
menu.description: Tossed with coastal seasonings. Served hot or cold with cocktail sauce and lemon.

menu.name: Fried Grouper Bites
menu.description: Marinated in our "Coastal Seasoning", hand-breaded, and served with our jalapeño remoulade. Perfect for sharing with the table, or just for yourself.

menu.name: Shrimp, Crab & Andouille Gumbo
menu.description: Succulent shrimp, cocktail crab claws, and smoky Andouille sausage in a rich and flavorful roux-based broth. Served with white rice.

menu.name: Crab Dip
menu.description: A piping hot blend of lump crab meat, cheeses, spinach, artichokes, and seasonings. Served with house-made garlic crostini.

menu.name: Mozzarella Sticks
menu.description: Six breaded and fried cheese sticks. Served with marinara sauce.

menu.name: Garlic Crab Claws
menu.description: Griddled with house butter. Served with house-made garlic crostini and lemon.

menu.name: Dinner Salad
menu.description: Onions, croutons, and our signature house vinaigrette dressing with your choice of protein.

menu.name: House Salad
menu.description: A smaller portion of our dinner salad.

menu.name: French Dip Sandwich
menu.description: Shaved roast prime rib, herb jus, Swiss cheese, and grilled onions.

menu.name: Cajun Prime Rib Sandwich
menu.description: Cajun-spiced shaved roast prime rib, Swiss cheese, grilled bell peppers & onions, mushrooms, and creole mustard.

menu.name: Crispy Fish Sandwich
menu.description: Hand-breaded fried fish, American cheese, lettuce, red onion, tomato, pickle, and remoulade.

menu.name: Grilled Chicken Sandwich
menu.description: Lemon pepper-spiced grilled chicken breast, lettuce, tomato, onion, pickle, and lemon garlic aioli.

menu.name: Cheeseburger
menu.description: 1/3 pound burger with cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomato, and onion.

menu.name: The Kraken
menu.description: This "Monster" of a burger starts with lettuce, tomato, onion, and burger patty cooked to order. Then it is topped with cheese, a crab cake, shaved prime rib, garlic aioli, and a fried shrimp topper. It is not for the faint of heart.

menu.name: Herb-Crusted Prime Rib
menu.description: Tender, juicy, and full of flavor, this perfectly cooked prime rib is coated in a savory blend of herbs, creating a delicious crust that adds depth and richness to every bite. Served with house-made horseradish and herb jus. Limited availability.

menu.name: Baby Back Ribs
menu.description: Dry-rubbed

menu.name: Sierra Nevada Wild Little Thing Sour
Tidal Wave
menu.description: Bring on the summer vibes with a mixture of Bacardi rum, simple syrup, Blue Curacao, lime juice, club soda, and muddled mint for a cool, refreshing flavor – who knows, a sea creature might be found floating around!

menu.name: Palm Breeze
menu.description: A top-tier margarita with a combination of Don Julio, margarita mix, a splash of orange juice, and Gran-Gala floater.

menu.name: Seaweed
menu.description: Enjoy the tropics with a combination of Malibu, Captain Morgan, melon liqueur, Blue Curacao, pineapple, and a splash of lime juice.

menu.name: Shady Palm
menu.description: Beat the heat with Tito's, simple syrup, sour mix, and a splash of lemon flavor.

menu.name: Beach, Please!
menu.description: Go to your happy place with Smirnoff, Peachtree liqueur, orange juice, pineapple juice, and a splash of cranberry.

menu.name: Happy Place
menu.description: Find your paradise with vodka, Peachtree liqueur, orange juice, Blue Curacao, peach puree, and a splash of lemon-lime.

menu.name: Hammered Sunset
menu.description: Bombay Sapphire gin, bitters, orange liqueur, simple syrup, and a freshly squeezed orange wedge, with a dash of orange juice and sweet vermouth topper.

specials.name: Cinco De Mayo
specials.description: Grab your best fiesta hat and join us for Cinco de Mayo!

specials.name: Mother's Day
specials.description: Join us on Mother's Day and treat your mom to a delicious meal!

specials.name: Memorial Day
specials.description: Come celebrate the long weekend with us!

specials.name: National Bourbon Day
specials.description: Join us on National Bourbon Day! Sit back, relax and sip on your favorite bourbon!

specials.name: Father's Day
specials.description: Treat your dad and join us for Father's Day!
